faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What format are the files in?

faq.a2: Yes. Every pack includes a royalty-free license for personal and commercial projects.
faq.q3: How do I receive my files?
faq.a3: After checkout on Gumroad, you get an instant download link and a delivery email.
faq.a4: Because files are digital, refunds are handled by Gumroad on a case-by-case basis.
